about_the_game:
Do you wish you could take care of your very own tiny pony creature?

Because in this game, you don't have a choice! We, at the Pakku Pony Digital Company are thrilled to give you your very own colourful best friend!

Just remember to feed your creature. We cannot guarantee what it might start eating if it ever gets too hungry.

The game is currently in development!

Features:

Full character customisation

Design and decorate your pony with a variety of hairstyles, colours, accessories, and cosmetics! Mix and match to create a creature that truly feels like yours!

Many mini-games on your little computer

Earn rewards and unlock special cosmetics when you keep your pony happy and entertained!

Garden Management

Your main source of income and ingredients. Tend to your crops, harvest fresh produce, and discover new seeds to expand your garden!

Kitchen and Cooking

Learn new recipes, serve your pony its favourite dishes, and see if your pony likes the food (some good... some questionable)!

Wait... Is the Creature Talking to Me?

Sometimes your pony seems a little too aware of what’s going on.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Pentium Gold 4415Y
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 615
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!
